name: Coherence → COHERENT: open the PR (open_pr)
description:
The delivery router (design D16, group 8D). When check_coherence derives COHERENT — the clean-room verify passed, the change validated, and every projected task is approved — deliver: force open_pr, which records pr.ref (the M0 local delivery reference; the M2 forge-io adapter records a live PR URL). This is the terminal of the m0 issue→PR arc. G2: this fires no lifecycle transition; open_pr stamps pr.ref, a rule closing the run reads it.

TRIGGER = the check_coherence LOOP terminal via the dev.coherence_decided loop marker. Fires on agent.loop.role=coordinator AND dev.coherence_decided eq "coherent" — a single LITERAL eq (#519-immune), mutually exclusive with the blocked router (12b) on the single decision value.

RUN BINDING: run_scope=inherit binds the open_pr loop to the coherence loop's agent.run, so open_pr stamps pr.ref on THIS run.

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe): on_enter FIRST stamps dev.pr_routed=$entity.instance on the coherence loop, guarded by dev.pr_routed length_eq 0. CRITICAL: publish_agent open_pr is NOT idempotent (a re-fire would open a second PR), so the marker (stamped BEFORE the publish) is load-bearing. The two delivery routers SHARE this one marker (mutually exclusive on the decision anyway).

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt: SEMDEV — the run cleared the coherence gate: the clean-room verify passed, the change validated, and every task is approved. Open the pull request: call open_pr. The harness records the delivery reference — you supply nothing and claim no outcome. Calling open_pr completes your turn.

metadata.trigger_rationale: fires on the check_coherence loop's dev.coherence_decided marker with a LITERAL eq "coherent" — #519-immune, mutually exclusive with the blocked router.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the LOOP-scoped dev.pr_routed marker + length_eq 0 guard, stamped BEFORE the publish. CRITICAL (not tidiness): open_pr is not idempotent — a re-fire without the guard opens a duplicate PR.
metadata.m0_honesty: at M0 pr.ref is a deterministic local-delivery stub (the real forge-io PR is M2); the gate that got here GENUINELY passed (real cold verify, real approved verdict, real openspec.validated), only the delivery target is stubbed — NOT semspec's placeholder-pass (which faked the verify outcome).
